pages.ogTitle: Onventis Expands Management Board: New Chief Product Officer (CPO) and Introduction of Chief AI Officer (CAIO)
h2: Onventis is restructuring its management level, consistently strengthening its strategic focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Sovereignty. Heiko Rumpl, previously Chief Product Officer, will assume responsibility for the company-wide AI strategy as the new Chief AI Officer (CAIO). The position of Chief Product Officer (CPO) will be taken over by Dolf van den Boorn, who has already played a key role in the strategic development of the Onventis platform.
